text: The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund (TAF) requests City Council authorization to receive $2 million in funding from Natural Resources Canada's Zero Emission Vehicle Infrastructure Program. TAF will use the funding to provide grants to eligible stakeholders throughout the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area to install electric vehicle charging infrastructure. The funding will support deployment of approximately 300 electric vehicle chargers, including 15 fast chargers, in public places, on streets and in multi-unit residential buildings. The TAF project aligns with the City's strategic priorities, including those of the TransformTO Climate Action Strategy and the Electric Vehicle Strategy. Additional details are provided as Attachment 1 of this report. A letter from Natural Resources Canada confirming conditional funding approval is provided as Attachment 2. Council…

City Council on June 8 and 9, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the Toronto Atmospheric Fund to receive $2 million from Natural Resources Canada's Zero Emission Vehicle Infrastructure Program, subject to the negotiation and execution of a Contribution Agreement between the Toronto Atmospheric Fund and Natural Resources Canada, the terms and conditions of which shall not result in unreasonable risk to the City of Toronto nor to the City's endowment to the Toronto Atmospheric Fund. 2.
